label: Hexagon Pocket
description: A hexagon chest pocket has angled lower corners that come to a shallow point, giving the patch a six-sided, faceted outline. The geometric shape is more distinctive and slightly more formal-looking than a plain rounded pocket. It adds a subtle bit of sartorial character to the breast of the shirt.
